name: Franciscan Missions in the Sierra Gorda of Querétaro
description: Five Franciscan mission churches rise from the rugged mountains of Querétaro state in central Mexico. They were built between 1750 and 1760 under Junípero Serra, who later founded missions in California. Their façades are covered in colourful Baroque stucco carving made by friars and local Indigenous artisans, and small villages still surround each church.
